correction_reason: The sequence-3 baseline changed after the RED commit, so this manifest re-freezes both test files at their final hashes. Two corrections were made while turning RED into GREEN, both of which strengthened the contract rather than relaxing it. (1) tests/test_commit_msg_trailer_regression.py: the D4 case originally used a line carrying a real 40-hex SHA, which is a GENUINE existing trailer that must be respected; the placeholder 'Test-Baseline: <sha>' is the actual prose false positive, and a control asserting the genuine trailer is still honoured was added. (2) tests/test_commit_msg_trailer.py: test_release_and_merge_subjects_are_skipped parametrised Revert and fixup! as expected-skip subjects. That assertion encoded defect D3 -- the guard's is_release_or_gov list does not exempt them, so those commits were silently left untrailered and then rejected with SOURCE_COMMIT_MISSING_BASELINE_TRAILER. The parametrisation was corrected to the guard's actual exemption list.
rationale: Superseding baseline for the KAN-179 Test-Baseline trailer helper fixes. RED: 10 failed, 2 passed. GREEN: 33 passed across both suites. The real scripts/test_provenance_guard.py is the end-to-end oracle, so helper formatting and decision bugs both reach the gate.
